payload.description: Modeled on an office. Every member holds an authority ceiling over the consequential classes and their arguments. The governing rule: no one can grant, approve, or always-allow beyond their own ceiling. Roles are named ceilings, not a permission matrix. Delegation clips and expires, using the table TTL. Approval routing escalates to the nearest sufficient ceiling, which gives the unattended path in docs/APPROVAL.md a completion route it did not have with one household human. AutoReviewRule gains a creator identity distinct from its user_id scope; approvals gain an approver identity. Visibility is a channel and named-resource property, never a filesystem one.
payload.title: Delegated approval authority and need-to-know visibility
